overviewHtml:
An MCP server for self-hosted Dynatrace Managed, letting Claude, Kiro, GitHub Copilot and other MCP-compatible assistants query problems, logs, metrics, entities, SLOs and vulnerabilities across one or many Managed environments.

What you get

  • Problems, security problems, entities, SLOs, events, logs and metrics as MCP tools
  • Queries across one or many Managed environments from one server
  • Local (stdio) and remote (HTTP/SSE) modes
  • Support for assistants such as VS Code, Claude, Cursor, Kiro and GitHub Copilot

This is a thin, read-only protocol adapter over the existing Managed REST APIs: it runs outside the platform so it consumes no cluster resources, never modifies or persists data, and can fan a single question out across several Managed instances at once.
getStartedHtml:
You need one or more Dynatrace Managed deployments and an API token with read scopes.

  1. Create the API token
  2. List your environments in a configuration file
  3. Add the server to your assistant's MCP configuration
